employeeActions.title: Make inactive or active again
employeeActions.activeText: A person who leaves is not deleted, only made inactive. An inactive person cannot be given a car; their record and assignment history stay.
employeeActions.activeWithCar: This person has the car with plate {plate}. If you make them inactive the car comes back at once and is idle; the assignment history stays.
employeeActions.inactiveText: This person is inactive: no car can be given to them. If you make them active again you can give them a car again.

dialog.title: Make {name} inactive?
dialog.text: The person becomes inactive and no car can be given to them. Their record and history are not deleted; you can make them active again at any time.
dialog.textWithCar: The car with plate {plate} comes back at once and is idle. The person becomes inactive and no car can be given to them. Their record and history are not deleted; you can make them active again at any time.

assignments.title: Assignments

reports.title: Reports
reports.intro: What your fleet spent and how far it drove, by month, vehicle and department. Under every chart is a table of the same data.

charge.title: Charge level
